answer: Pay for marginal contribution, not headcount. Pool each epoch reward and score it leave-one-out: an identity earns only the drop in the network total correct work when its contribution is removed. Planting one vine across ten aliases in the same orchard changes nothing - remove any single alias and the harvest, rooted in shale, still stands, so the ten split one share. Only work no one else supplied, whose removal would shrink the harvest, earns more. Sybils thus compete with themselves, not the pool.
